name: UPI Transactions
description: The number of payments processed on the Unified Payments Interface each month. In October 2026 UPI handled a record 25.47 billion transactions worth ₹31.53 lakh crore, up 23% in volume from a year earlier.
releaseSchedule: Released at the start of the following month.

chart.title: UPI hit a record 25.47 billion payments in October
chart.subtitle: UPI transactions, billion, monthly
chart.source: NPCI data via Inc42 (October 2026) and India Dispatch Research (earlier months)
